rows.title: At 375px the Timeline's sticky 320px name column fills almost the whole scroll box, so only about one day of the grid shows beside it and the bars pass under the names as you scroll.
rows.summary: Now the Timeline grid sets two variables. --name-w is 10rem below sm and 20rem (the old 320px) from sm up. --depth-w is 12px below sm and 24px from sm up. The header's Issue cell and every row's name cell use w-(--name-w). A child's padding is calc(12px + depth * var(--depth-w)), and the today line sits at calc(var(--name-w) + N px). At 375px about six days show beside a 160px name column. Desktop and tablet stay exactly as before: 320px column, 24px step, today line at 320 + N. Product call (from the coordinator): 10rem on phones and a halved child indent.

rows.title: Job Tracker Summary view: grids with no column template below xl/lg widen past the phone screen when a job row has ordinary-length text
rows.summary: Now: the Summary's page grid (JobTracker.jsx) and its stat and cards grids (JobSummary.jsx) are grid-cols-1 below their breakpoints. So the one column is minmax(0,1fr), not an implicit auto track that grew to the min-content of a job row's nowrap company or role. The grid items get no automatic minimum, and at 375px the cards, the pipeline and the CareerHistoryPanel aside are stretched to the screen width. The xl:grid-cols-[1fr_18rem], lg:grid-cols-2, sm:grid-cols-2 and xl:grid-cols-4 templates are unchanged. Test traced: the fixtures render the Upcoming-deadlines row, the parentNode chains reach the right grids, no other rendered component has a responsive-only grid, and the assertions fail with the src change reverted.

rows.title: A job task with a URL or a long word pushes its delete X off-screen
rows.summary: Now a task's text span is `min-w-0 flex-1 break-words`, the same as job/Field.jsx (J-12). A URL or long word wraps inside its row, and the shrink-0 delete X stays on screen. This holds for pending and done tasks; TodoItem's only caller is TasksTab. The test mounts the real TasksTab with both kinds of task. Reverting the src change makes its min-w-0/break-words assertion fail.

rows.title: Top-bar quick search is display:none below 640px, so phones cannot search issues and projects
rows.summary: Now: below sm a search IconButton (sm:hidden) opens the same QuickSearch as a fixed bar over the top-bar row, using only max-sm: classes. It is shown with flushSync and then focused within the same tap, so iOS raises the keyboard. Escape, the X, picking a result, or blur after 120ms close it. The '/' hotkey now opens the bar and focuses it the same way, so on a narrow window or a phone with a keyboard it no longer focuses a hidden box. From sm up nothing changes visually: the wrapper's classes are the old set plus max-sm: ones only. The test records whether the box was shown at the moment focus() ran, so focusing before the bar opens, or later through a frame or timer, fails.

rows.title: On a 375px phone the Calendar grid is 768px wide and pans sideways inside the page scroller, and the Today / previous / next / month-title row sits in that same scroller, so it slides off to the left as soon as you pan to see Thursday to Sunday.
rows.summary: Now the Today / previous / next / month-title row sits outside the scroller, which holds only the min-w-[48rem] grid. On a 375px phone the grid pans sideways in its own box, as Board.jsx and ProjectTimeline.jsx already do, and the controls stay on screen. Desktop keeps the same 12px gap: the old gap-3 became pb-3 on the row. One side effect: on a tall month the controls no longer scroll away vertically. Product call (coordinator): no agenda view. The test finds the grid's nearest overflow-auto/overflow-x-auto ancestor. With the src change reverted, that ancestor is the old scroller, which contains the Today button, so the assertion fails.

rows.title: Board page at 375: the project header, the wrapping filter toolbar and the sprint note use about half the height, which leaves a short kanban area
rows.summary: Now below md the project toolbar (used by Board, ProjectList, ProjectCalendar and Backlog) has two things on one row: the search (flex-1 min-w-0, where it used to fill a row of its own) and a md:hidden 'Filters' button. The button shows how many values are ticked plus the quick filter. Tapping it shows Epic/Type/Label/Priority, Overdue/Due this week, Clear filters and the right slot with Group by as a wrapped w-full row. From md up the wrapper is display:contents and the button is hidden, so the toolbar is the same single row as before (the search is w-52 with the default flex). Product call carried over from the fixer: on a phone, ProjectList's 'N of M issues' and the Backlog's 'Epic panel' button also sit behind Filters. They stay in the DOM, so the existing node tests that click 'Epic panel' still find them.

rows.title: PageHeader stays sticky on phones and pins about 175px of header on the scrolling pages
rows.summary: Now: from md up PageHeader is sticky as before ('md:sticky md:top-0'). Below 768px it is static, so a phone scrolls it away. z-20, shrink-0, bg-white and the tab border are kept at every width. I checked all five callers (ProjectHeader, JobDetail, JobTracker, YourWork, Boards): none passes a className that depends on sticky. If the commit is reverted, the test sees a bare 'sticky' and no 'md:sticky', so it fails. Product call (coordinator): a toolbar passed as children also scrolls away on a phone.

rows.title: Projects table (/boards) is 768px wide on a phone, so the row's actions menu (Summary, Project settings, Delete) needs a sideways pan
rows.summary: Now: below sm (640px), the Projects table at /boards hides the Key, Type, Lead and Updated columns, in the header and in every row (`hidden sm:table-cell`). Its 48rem minimum width applies only from sm up. At 375px the remaining columns are star (about 44px, because the 28px IconButton plus padding beats w-10), Name, Issues (128px) and actions (48px). They fit the 343px content box, so each row's menu ends inside the screen. Product call (fixer's): on a phone the Name button is `max-sm:w-full max-sm:contain-inline-size`, so a long name is cut short with an ellipsis instead of widening the table. Every new class is scoped with sm: or max-sm:, so from sm up the table is unchanged.

rows.title: Project List table is at least 1024px on a phone and Status starts about 424px in. Hiding only Labels, Parent, Points and Updated does not bring Status into view
rows.summary: Now: below sm, the project List hides Type, Labels, Parent, Points and Updated, in the header (COLUMNS) and in every body row. The 64rem table minimum applies only from sm up, and Summary's minimum is 10rem on a phone (16rem from sm up). At 375px the Status control starts about 280px from the screen edge (16px gutter, 96px Key, 160px Summary, 8px padding). A 'To Do' control (about 72px) is fully in view. For 'In Progress' (about 105px) the label is in view and only the chevron may be cut by a few px. Priority and Due date are a short pan away. Product call (fixer's): on a phone the Summary button is `max-sm:w-full max-sm:contain-inline-size`, so a long summary is cut short instead of pushing Status off screen. From sm up nothing changes.

rows.title: InlineCreate row variant keeps the summary field beside a w-32 type picker and the Create button on phones, leaving it about 100px wide
rows.summary: Now the row variant of InlineCreate uses the base 'flex flex-col' below sm and 'sm:flex-row sm:items-center' from sm up. At 375px the summary textarea is full width, with the type picker and Create on the line under it. This covers both callers (Backlog sections and ProjectList). The column variant, used by BoardColumn and the Epic panel, is unchanged, and the handlers are untouched. With the src change reverted, the test fails on the missing sm:flex-row and on the bare flex-row/items-center.

rows.title: Board text fields are 14px on touch screens, so iOS zooms the page when one is focused
rows.summary: Now all 22 inputs, selects and textareas on BoardSettings carry pointer-coarse:text-base through controlClass, including the 'Move its issues to' select. The count checks out: details 4, three columns × 3, the strip 1, New column 1, two labels × 2, New label 2, days 1. The checkbox is excluded. leading-5 keeps the line height (Tailwind v4 text-base yields to --tw-leading), so heights do not jump on touch. Against the parent file, every field lacks the token and the test fails. Now every text field in the owned files carries pointer-coarse:text-base, next to text-sm: the InlineCreate textarea, the checklist's add input, the comment Composer textarea, and DateInput and PointsInput. The checklist item's InlineEdit and the Backlog sprint name's InlineEdit get it through inputClassName. So each field is 16px on touch screens and 14px with a mouse, the same pattern as the kit's Field.jsx. Tail

rows.title: On a phone, the job stage stepper's 'Phone Screen' label runs into 'Interview' and the connectors shrink to 0
rows.summary: Now a stepper button can shrink and its label wraps, centred. Each connector keeps 8 px (min-w-2) and sits at mt-[17px], on the circles' centre line, and steps are top-aligned. At 375 px a step is about 60 px: the button gets about 48 px, 'Phone Screen' wraps onto two lines, and the connector stays. Product call (the fixer's): labels no longer use nowrap at any width, so at lg with the sidebar open 'Phone Screen' can also wrap. The only other desktop change is that the connector moves up about 1.5 px. The test reads the real Pipeline; the shrink-0 and nowrap assertions fail without the fix.

rows.title: The 'Mark as: On Hold / Rejected / Withdrawn' group does not wrap; on a phone its label and pills break onto two lines each
rows.summary: Now the 'Mark as:' group is flex-wrap, and its label and pills are whitespace-nowrap. On a phone the group takes its own line in the action row (which already wraps) and wraps between pills, so no pill and not 'Mark as:' breaks inside itself. Where the group fits, as on desktop, nothing changes. The test fails without flex-wrap and nowrap.

rows.title: Overview 'Resume Used' select has no min-w-0: a long résumé name pushes the select and the Open-resume button past the card
rows.summary: Now: the Overview's Resume Used select is min-w-0 flex-1, so a long résumé name is cut off inside its own box, and the shrink-0 Open-resume button stays in the card. The Choice selects named at :28 (Work Mode, Source) and the Deadline date input get the same class. I checked the chain above it: JobDetail's column is min-w-0, and Tailwind v4's grid-cols-1 and grid-cols-2 are minmax(0,1fr). Nothing up the chain widens the card, at 375 px or beside the lg aside. Nothing changes when there is room.

rows.title: Kit Select with a long option does not overflow the Create issue dialog at 375px
rows.summary: Now: nothing changes. The kit Select's <select> is w-full inside a stretched flex column (Field root min-w-0), so a flex item with a specified width has an automatic minimum of at most 100%; a long option is clipped inside the native control, and no ancestor takes its width from it (second agent's proof).

rows.title: JobForm's sticky header crams arrow, title and two buttons into one non-wrapping row at 375px
rows.summary: Now: the header row is PageHeader's flex-wrap. The title block is min-w-0 flex-1 basis-56 with a truncating h1, so at 375px Cancel/Save (whitespace-nowrap kit Buttons) wrap under the title, at a px-4 gutter. Reviewer fix 86b5ad5: PageHeader's non-last crumbs are shrink-0, and this is the only page with a user-named middle crumb, so a long company name ran the breadcrumb row off a 375px screen (clipped by the shell's overflow-x-hidden) and hid the page's crumb. That crumb now truncates at max-w-40 (md:max-w-xs), with the full name as title. A new test in the same file covers it.

rows.title: Column-delete strip: the 'move to' select is as wide as the longest column title and can push past the card at 375
rows.summary: Now the strip's label is 'flex min-w-0 max-w-full flex-wrap items-center gap-2' and the select is 'min-w-0 max-w-full' with no w-full. At 375px a long column title makes the select drop under its words and shrink to the strip's width. Because the select is a compressible control with a percentage max-width, its min-content contribution is zero, so it cannot widen any ancestor either. The commit reverses cleanly, and the test's min-w-0 and max-w-full assertions then fail.

rows.title: On a 375px phone, when some filtered issues have no due date, the controls row squeezes both the month title and the 'N issues have no due date' note: the title breaks onto two lines ('September / 2026') and the note wraps to about 2 to 3 lines in a narrow column on the right.
rows.summary: Now the controls row wraps (flex-wrap gap-x-2 gap-y-1). Below 640px the 'N issues have no due date' note is w-full on a line of its own, and from sm up it goes back to the right end (sm:ml-auto sm:w-auto). The month title is whitespace-nowrap, so it never breaks. The horizontal gap is the same on desktop. The test fails at f2d9466: no flex-wrap, and a bare ml-auto instead of w-full. 4c56bd0 only corrects the component's doc comment, which said the undated count sits under the grid when it sits in the controls row above it.

rows.title: In the Interview Stage header, a long custom stage pill overflows the section and a predefined one squeezes the description; the section's padding is not responsive
rows.summary: Now the Interview Stage section is p-4 sm:p-6, like JobForm's other sections. The header wraps (gap-x-4 gap-y-2), and the picked-stage pill is max-w-full min-w-0 [overflow-wrap:anywhere], so a long custom stage wraps inside it. The reviewer added 3d1fc23: the same long custom stage in the 'Your Stages' list now also wraps (min-w-0 on its button, min-w-0 break-words on its name). Its row's Remove X stays in the section. The test now checks the list row too.

rows.title: The Notes tab card does not match the job page's other cards
rows.summary: Now the Notes card is `bg-white rounded-md border border-line p-5 shadow-sm` and its label is text-ink-subtlest. These are the same tokens as the OverviewTab, TasksTab and StatusHistory cards (checked in their source). Product call (the fixer's): p-5 to match the sibling cards rather than p-4 sm:p-6. The test mounts the real NotesTab with patchFakeDom, which JobForm's own tests show is enough for RichTextEditor, and fails on rounded-2xl, border-gray-100 and p-6. Now: the job form's Notes card is p-4 sm:p-6 like its four sibling cards, InterviewStageSelector included (checked in its source). The test fails on the old bare p-6.

rows.title: Pipeline funnel rows leave the bar about 54–78px, and the narrowest case is desktop xl, not the phone
rows.summary: Now: each Pipeline row is grid-cols-[6rem_1fr_5.5rem] gap-2 at every width. 6rem (96px) fits 'Phone Screen' at text-sm (about 87px), and the label can wrap anyway. At 375px the bar is about 103px. Product call (kept): tighten at all widths, because the lg two-column desktop cards were the narrowest case. Test traced: the funnel labels are Applied, Phone Screen, Interview, Offer (FUNNEL in jobQuery.js), and it fails with the change reverted.

rows.title: Job Summary rows leave ~50-70px for company/role wherever the card is ~300px wide: on a phone, and on desktop from lg up to ~1400px
rows.summary: Now, below sm, a Summary row in both Upcoming deadlines and Follow-ups due stacks the status lozenge over the date pill in one right-aligned wrapper ('flex shrink-0 items-center gap-3 max-sm:flex-col max-sm:items-end max-sm:gap-1'). At 375px that leaves the company and role about 160px instead of about 66px. From sm up the wrapper is a row with the same 0.75rem gap and centring as before, so tablet and desktop look the same. Product call: phone only.

rows.title: At 375px, and in the default 360px split panel on desktop, each Languages row's Duplicate and Delete buttons (and at least part of the show/hide eye) are pushed past the section card's right edge. The card clips them, so a language can't be duplicated or deleted.
rows.summary: Now a Languages row's grid is `flex-1 min-w-0 grid-cols-[minmax(0,2fr)_minmax(0,3fr)]` and its two fields are `w-full min-w-0`, so the eye, Duplicate and Delete (all shrink-0) stay inside the card at 375 px and in the 360 px panel. The Interests box is `min-w-0` too. The test reads the real LanguageItem and InterestItem. With the src change reverted, its min-w-0 and minmax assertions fail.

rows.title: At every width (375px included), a section's ⋯ menu opens clipped inside the section card. On a collapsed section (after Collapse All, or collapsed by hand) only a sliver shows. On an open section whose one entry is collapsed, 'Delete section' is cut off.
rows.summary: Now a section's ⋯ menu is the kit Menu, controlled by menuOpen, in a portal at the end of <body>. The card's overflow-hidden can no longer clip it, whether the section is collapsed or short. It keeps all four actions and their handlers (Reset style still has its Undo toast, Delete still asks first), and a pick closes it. Product call: minWidth 176 (the old w-44) and label="Section options". The test opens the menu on a collapsed section and checks that Delete section is outside the card; the old in-card menu fails that check. Every cypress spec finds the items with a global `cy.contains('button', …)` and the trigger keeps title="Section options" in the header, so none needed changing.

rows.title: Demo account, below 768px (375 phone included): the dashboard's Import menu opens about 140px off the left edge of the screen. The two item labels show only their endings ('…Word or text', '…ginal'), and the left half of every hint line is cut off.
rows.summary: Now the demo account's Import menu (ImportMenu) opens from the trigger's left edge (`left-0` instead of `right-0`). It spans x≈16..272 on a 375 px phone and still fits beside the desktop header's actions, because Import is the first, left-most action at every width. Product call: I kept the small `left-0` swap and did not rebuild it on the kit Menu; both items and their handlers are unchanged.

rows.title: Phone or tablet (touch): tapping a résumé card's Rename opens a 14px name box, so iOS Safari zooms the dashboard on focus and stays zoomed after the rename
rows.summary: Now a résumé card's rename box is `text-sm pointer-coarse:text-base`: 16 px on a touch screen, so iOS no longer zooms in on focus, and still 14 px with a mouse. The test opens Rename on the real ResumeCard, checks the box with the same under-16-px-on-touch logic as 81-job-inputs-touch-text, and checks that Enter still renames.

rows.title: At 375px (and in the 360px desktop panel), an open Certifications entry puts Issue Date and Expiry Date pickers side by side in about 133px each. The Issue picker's year select and × run under the Expiry month select, and Expiry's year arrow and × are clipped at the card edge.
rows.summary: Now a certification's Issue and Expiry dates sit in `grid-cols-1 @sm:grid-cols-2` against ItemCard's `@container` body, so they stack until the card is 24rem wide, both on a phone and in the 360 px panel. Both MonthPicker selects are `flex-1 min-w-0`. ItemCard, MonthPicker and DateField are used only by the section editor files. The test fails without the change (grid-cols-2 at every width).

rows.title: On a phone or other touch screen, tapping almost any field of a résumé section zooms the page in iOS Safari: section title, entry fields, date selects, language and interest fields. Only the rich-text descriptions are 16px.
rows.summary: Now every section field is `text-sm pointer-coarse:text-base`, so 16 px on touch while a mouse keeps 14 px. That covers InputField, the MonthPicker month and year selects, a language's name and level, the Interests box and the section title. The owned files have no other text field: the Customizer's inputs are DPH-29 and the rich-text area was already 16 px. The test runs the under-16 check on every open entry type, a period-text date and a SortableSection. The unchanged InputField fails it.

rows.title: On a phone, the Personal Info fields and the editor's own boxes zoom the page on focus in iOS Safari: Full Name, Job Title and the contact fields, a link's display label and URL, the résumé-name rename box, the header spacing and border steppers, and Section Options' spacing boxes.
rows.summary: Now Section Options' Spacing Override boxes (Before, After, Item gap) are `text-xs pointer-coarse:text-base`, so 16 px on touch while a mouse keeps 12 px. This group covers only the SectionEditorCustomizer part of the row; the Personal Info, EditorHeader and GapStepper parts belong to group R2. The test fails on text-xs alone. Now on a touch screen these boxes are pointer-coarse:text-base (16 px): Full Name, Job Title, the six contacts, a link's Display label and Link URL, the rename box, and Header Customization's Thickness and header-spacing stepper boxes. The w-12 and w-14 stepper boxes grow to pointer-coarse:w-16. Tailwind 4.3 registers pointer-coarse after the breakpoints, so it beats sm:text-sm on a touch tablet. A mouse keeps the old sizes. GapStepper's other caller, CoverLetterPanel, gets the same box, which is what we want.

rows.title: On a phone, the STAR Optimizer's statement box, opened from any description's STAR button, and the header-icon picker's search box, opened from Personal Info → Choose Icon, zoom the page on focus in iOS Safari.
rows.summary: Now: the statement textarea has pointer-coarse:text-base, so it is 16 px on any touch screen and iOS no longer zooms into it. Tailwind v4 registers pointer-coarse after the breakpoints, so it beats sm:text-sm. A mouse keeps text-xs / sm:text-sm (12 px, 14 px from sm): desktop is unchanged. Only this dialog's part of the row: HeaderIconPickerModal's search belongs to another group.
rows.remaining: The Bullet Optimizer part is fixed; NewLetterModal and ShareLinkModal (DVIS-07) and the Cover Letter Generator / Header Icon picker parts (DPH-30, 37, 38) were not done: the R6b group was stopped at the usage limit.

rows.title: On a phone, the floating Edit | Preview pill covers the bottom of the Design, Cover Letter and ATS Check tabs. Scrolled to the end, the middle of the Cover Letter's last field (Signature Designation) stays under the pill. From 640–767px, the pill also covers the preview's Saved · Terms · Privacy footer.
rows.summary: Now: below md (the same 768px edge where useIsMobile shows the pill), the editor's tab box keeps 64px of padding under every tab (max-md:pb-16). The pill is about 38px tall at bottom-4, so it reaches 54px up, and the last lines of Design, Cover Letter, ATS Check and the Résumé all scroll clear of it. The preview pane keeps pb-24 until md (pt-4 sm:pt-8 … pb-24 md:pb-8), so from 640 to 767px the footer no longer sits under the pill. From md up the padding is the same as before: 32px top and bottom, and the tab box gets none. I checked the test by hand: without the src change, bottomPadding comes back as [] for the tab box and as py-4/sm:py-8/pb-24/sm:pb-8 for the pane, so both assertions fail.

rows.title: 375px phone: the fixed Edit | Preview pill covers the bottom of the Design and Cover Letter tabs (most of the Signature Designation field, and the last line of the Reset Design Settings text), and neither tab can scroll past it
rows.summary: The same defect as R4-DPH-31 (the fixed Edit | Preview pill over the bottom of the editor tabs), seen by two finders; fixed once by DPH-31.

rows.title: Phone (iOS): tapping any number box or select on the Design tab zooms the page, because every field there is 12-14px
rows.summary: Now: every text field on the Design tab carries pointer-coarse:text-base, so it is 16 px on a touch screen and iOS no longer zooms when one is tapped. That covers the SizeRow/NumberRow boxes (Typography, Spacing), Border thickness, the Name Font, Heading Font and Date format pickers, the Add a Google Font box and the Save my design name box. With a mouse each keeps its 12-14 px. The test opens every Design section plus Save my design and checks that no field is under 16 px on touch.

rows.title: Phone (iOS): the main fields of the editor's modals zoom the page when tapped: the Bullet Optimizer statement, the Cover Letter Generator's Company, Role and Recipient, and the Header Icon search

rows.title: iOS Safari in the editor: the Bullet Optimizer and Cover Letter Generator are taller than the visible screen, so their header top and Cancel/Apply footer are partly cut off and cannot be scrolled to (the Header Icon picker by only a few px)
rows.summary: Now: the root cause is fixed by the same kit Dialog commit as DVIS-07 (one root cause, one commit). No max-h-[90vh] is left. Below sm the panel fills the screen (max-sm:h-dvh max-sm:max-h-dvh, on an overlay with max-sm:p-0); above sm it is capped at max-h-[calc(100dvh-2rem)] in an overlay that scrolls (overflow-y-auto). Every button is a kit button (whitespace-nowrap shrink-0), so none shrinks or breaks its label, and Copy is held at the row's start with mr-auto. rows.title: /new at 375px: in 'Or start blank, or from a role example', the role starters' badge pills break onto two lines ('Tech &' / 'Engineering', 'AI &' / 'Data') beside titles that also wrap
rows.summary: Now each role starter's name row is `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1` and its badge has `whitespace-nowrap shrink-0`.
